current.text: Portland is crowded at guard. Damian Lillard, Ja Morant, Jrue Holiday, Deni Avdija and Scoot Henderson all handle the ball, and Shaedon Sharpe also comes off the bench.
Portland's projected starting five is Lillard, Morant, Camara, Avdija and Clingan. Krejčí is not in it.
Portland is short on forwards. It lost Jerami Grant, Matisse Thybulle, Kris Murray, Caleb Love and Blake Wesley, and Avdija and Camara are basically its only forwards.
Minutes and usage across Portland's rotation are expected to swing from game to game.
Portland has a new head coach this season.

note: No expert note covers Krejčí. Both sites value him at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 280, ESPN rank 201), so he will not be one of the 144 players drafted in our league. The site projections disagree a lot (Yahoo 39.8% FG with 1.4 TO, ESPN 49.6% FG in 25.7 minutes), and he has no category that stands out. Watch on waivers early in the season to see whether Portland's lack of forwards gives him more than his usual 20 to 21 minutes.
